purpose: Record the reusable non-canonical interpretation boundary for HeartFetter ConditionType=7 after full-population source-description cross-validation rejected a universal ConditionParam-to-activation-job mapping.

hypothesis.statement: For HeartFetter Lv4/Lv7 ConditionType=7 records, each ConditionParam is a structurally confirmed same-hero explicit JobInfo reference. It has a strong job/class relationship but is not universally the source-named activation or display job.
confidenceBasis: All 1,158 ConditionType=7 params resolve to JobInfo.ID and belong to the same frozen hero's explicit normal/SP job set.
1,154 of 1,158 current projection rows contain the ConditionParam job name in at least one linked Skill/Buff source description.
Four Ainz rows explicitly name the opposite final job in both Skill and Buff source descriptions, so ConditionParam cannot be universally treated as the activation/display job.
Kagura still provides direct evidence of job/class-specific HeartFetter behavior while also demonstrating Skill/Buff cross-link differences.
unresolvedDetails: The exact runtime comparator or evaluator branch for ConditionType=7 is not directly observed.
The exact reason the four Ainz ConditionParam references point to the opposite source-named final job remains unresolved.
A presentation mapping must be exception-aware and independently owned; it must not silently equate ConditionParam with activation/display job.

reopenConditions: A post-HeartFetter runtime evaluator resolves the exact ConditionType=7 comparator or explains the Ainz inverse references.
A current source-pack record with ConditionType=7 has a ConditionParam that does not resolve to the same hero's explicit JobInfo set.
A source/contract/schema change invalidates the referenced validation evidence.
completion: CT7 is retained as a 100% structurally confirmed same-hero JobInfo reference, while the former universal activation/display-job hypothesis is explicitly rejected. Canonical and production consumers remain closed pending an exception-aware presentation mapping or exact runtime semantics.
